mathematics_and_language.finite_conditional_expectation: On all eight paths, M0=M1=3, M2=S2^2+1, M3=X, and the conditional/tower/martingale residuals are exactly zero at the printed precision.
mathematics_and_language.bounded_stopping: On all 64 six-step paths, 56 hit +/-2 and 8 remain at 0; E[S_(tau_b)]=0.
mathematics_and_language.unbounded_stopping_diagnostic: At cap 12, 3172 of 4096 paths hit +1, E[S_(tau_+ wedge 12)]=0, and the hit-only mean is 1. The text correctly identifies censoring and failure of uniform integrability rather than a failure of optional stopping.
mathematics_and_language.independent_label_check: The actual stopping-time means are E[tau_b]=7/2 and E[tau_+ wedge 12]=4751/1024; the reader now labels its zero-valued columns explicitly as means of S at the stopped times, not means of the stopping times.
mathematics_and_language.proof_enumeration_boundary: Finite enumeration is presented as an exact diagnostic for the cap and explicitly not as proof of the asymptotic statement.

corrected all four relative theory links and the hypothesis-audit fragment
